tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: ONE named instrument, in full. Returns the Martingale Score (0-5), the current Startingale reading, the sector (with the industry for stocks), the score breakdown, the sequence structure (spacing, rounds, quantity multipliers) and exchange availability for a single crypto or US stock, looked up by i

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: THE QUERY TOOL: finds instruments matching criteria within one asset class and returns a ranked list. Filters on minimum Martingale Score, minimum Startingale, exchange, round count, sector and count. It is the only tool that filters on exchange, round count or a minimum Martingale Score; list_top_c

tools.name: list_top_crypto
tools.description: A RANKED LIST OF CRYPTOS of a chosen size: a count (1-20), an optional minimum Startingale and an optional sector. Those are its only filters; a venue, a round count and a minimum Martingale Score are filters of search_instruments. crypto_overview returns a fixed top 5 with no arguments. Answers in
